clarifications.Ce: I have no requirement on the energy rating.

requirements.description: Prefers proximity to parks; threshold is the 75th percentile (89.49), rounded to the nearest integer.
The request specifies an existing commercial unit.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar' AND green >= 89 ORDER BY id ASC
